test_overview: Evaluated the SuperAdmin organization management test plan against the procurement web app at http://localhost:8000. All 9 steps passed with full points. SuperAdmin login redirects to an Organizations dashboard with summary counts (Total Orgs/Users, Active/Inactive). The SuperAdmin sidebar contains no procurement links, and direct navigation to a discovered procurement URL (/purchase-requests, obtained via a separate org-admin session) returns an 'Access Denied' page. Organization creation enforces validation: empty name and 1-character name are rejected via HTML5 validation, valid orgs are created as Active with 0 users, and duplicate names are rejected. Organization detail view shows name, status, creation date, user count, and user list. Status toggle works (Active->Inactive and back). Status filtering correctly shows only active orgs (excluding Inactive Acme) and only inactive orgs (only Acme). Sorting by name yields correct A->Z order. Delete requires a case-sensitive exact name match (lowercase 'beta industries' keeps the confirm button disabled; exact 'Beta Industries' enables it and deletion succeeds, removing it from the list). SuperAdmin user visibility is implemented via per-organization detail-view user lists (no global Users page) with Default Organization containing the 'admin' user, Acme showing 0 users, and no edit/delete actions for existing users (read-only). No failures encountered. Total score 70/70.

steps.description: test_superadmin_login_and_dashboard: Logged in as superadmin/super123. Redirected / -> /login -> /organizations. Dashboard shows org list and summary counts (Total Orgs=1, Users=1, Active=1, Inactive=0). 'Default Organization' present in list with status Active. Passed all checks.

test_superadmin_procurement_access_restrictions: SuperAdmin UI shows no procurement links (sidebar only 'Organizations'). Discovered a real procurement URL (/purchase-requests) via org-admin context_B (admin/admin123). SuperAdmin direct navigation to it rendered 'Access Denied / You do not have permission to access this page.' Procurement page content not visible. Passed.

test_create_organization_with_validation: Empty org name rejected (HTML5 'Please fill out this field.'). 1-char 'A' rejected (HTML5 minlength, needs >=2 chars). 'Acme Corporation' created (Active, 0 users) and appears in list. Duplicate 'Acme Corporation' rejected via 'Organization name already exists'. Passed.
test_create_second_organization: 'Beta Industries' created and appears in list with status Active and 0 users. Passed.
test_view_organization_details: Acme Corporation detail view (/organizations/2) shows name 'Acme Corporation', status 'Active', creation date, user count 0, and empty user list section. Passed.

test_toggle_organization_status_and_filter: Toggled Acme Active->Inactive (status shows Inactive). Active filter shows Default+Beta, not Acme. Inactive filter shows only Acme. Cleared filter. Restored Acme to Active. Passed.
test_sort_organizations_by_name: Applied Sort: Name (A->Z). DOM order of name cells: Acme Corporation, Beta Industries, Default Organization. Matches required A->Z order. Passed.

test_delete_organization_case_sensitive_confirmation: Opened Beta Industries detail, initiated deletion. Confirmation requires 'Type Beta Industries to confirm (case-sensitive)'. Confirm disabled when empty. Lowercase 'beta industries' keeps confirm disabled (rejected). Exact case 'Beta Industries' enabled confirm; deletion succeeded and Beta removed from list. Passed.

test_superadmin_user_visibility_read_only: SuperAdmin user listing via per-org detail-view user lists (acceptable; no global page). Default Organization contains user 'admin' (admin/Administrator/admin@default.local/admin/Active). Acme shows 0 users. No edit/delete actions for existing users (read-only); only org-level actions and '+ Provision Admin'. Passed.
